intent: A small, deterministic, seeded regional-event pool evaluated once per campaign Day inside AdvanceDay(). Designed to create reasons to move and to make the map feel alive WITHOUT spam, invented systems, or a second save/combat/diplomacy authority.

determinism.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
determinism.evaluation_hook: USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::AdvanceDay (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp:630), immediately AFTER FSoulCampaignRules::AdvanceDay(Economy) increments Economy.Day and BEFORE AdvanceEnemyAI().
determinism.max_events_per_day: start 1; scale +1 per 6 owned regions (cap 3). Prevents spam; evaluated deterministically in stable id order.
determinism.dedupe: fired_events_by_day (TMap<FName,int32>) prevents the same event firing twice within its cooldown; persisted in the Soul.Campaign save blob.
determinism.tie_break: equal eligibility -> lower stable event id wins, then lower region id (AGENTS.md stable tie-break).

fields.earliest_day: int, event cannot fire before this Day.
fields.cooldown_days: int, minimum days between two firings of the same event.
fields.base_chance_permille: int 0..1000, rolled via Rng.RandRange(0,999) < base_chance_permille (same permille convention as SoulCombat).
fields.requires: list of boolean predicates over VERIFIED campaign state (owned_region_count, has_neutral_neighbor, at_war_with_any, treasury_gold, hero_available).
fields.scope_region: how the target region is chosen: owned_frontier | neutral_adjacent | road_edge | any_owned.

effect_grammar.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL - every effect maps to a VERIFIED existing authority

effects.spawn_activity: injects a transient activity_site (schema: strategic_activity_schema.json) with window_days; expires automatically.
effects.modify_relation: FSoulDiplomacyRules::Apply OR nudge RelationPermille on an entry of HumanRelations (VERIFIED).
effects.grow_pool: Economy.RecruitmentPools[id].Available += amount, clamped to Capacity (VERIFIED pattern in AdvanceDay barracks bonus).
effects.raise_threat: add to the FSoulStrategicRegion.Threat/ResourceValue the AI snapshot reads (see ai_site_interest.md).
effects.reveal_vision: FSoulWorldRules::RefreshVision for the player faction around a region (VERIFIED).

events.name: Border Raid
events.player_prompt: Raiders strike {region}. Defend it or lose standing.
events.detour_reason: Forces a defensive reposition; makes frontier holding meaningful. No damage is auto-applied; it raises AI threat and seeds commander memory only.
events.ai_relevance: The owning AI faction's DefendOwnedRegion score rises for {region}.

events.name: Merchant Caravan
events.player_prompt: A merchant caravan on the {region} road offers payment for escort (3 days).
events.detour_reason: Time-limited positive-sum opportunity along RoadNeighbors; the escort reward is paid if the player (or a protective garrison) is adjacent when the window closes.
events.ai_relevance: Opportunistic AI may intercept the caravan for the same gold (contested).

events.name: Enemy Resource Convoy
events.player_prompt: An enemy supply convoy crosses {region}. Intercept within 2 days.
events.detour_reason: Raiding an enemy convoy denies them income and rewards the raider; pairs the war state with a positive map objective.
events.ai_relevance: If the convoy survives, the owning AI gains the gold instead (grant_resource to AI treasury).

events.name: Displaced Villagers

effects.note: small goodwill with the nearest same-biome faction

events.player_prompt: Refugees from {region} seek shelter. Accept them (recruits + goodwill) or decline.
events.detour_reason: A low-stakes moral/strategic choice that feeds recruitment and diplomacy; declining has no penalty (keeps Nature/Dark passivity compatible).
events.ai_relevance: Sheltering refugees in a frontier region slightly raises its Value in the AI snapshot.

events.name: The Den Stirs
events.player_prompt: Beasts from a nearby den grow bold near {region}.
events.detour_reason: Gives an uncleared monster_den (e.g. activity.monster_den.forest_edge) a nagging consequence, nudging the player to clear it. Deterministic and self-limiting (fires only while a den is uncleared).
events.ai_relevance: Raises Threat near the den so the AI deprioritises expansion there until cleared.

events.name: Market Boom
events.player_prompt: Trade flourishes; your market earns a windfall (+120 gold).
events.detour_reason: Rewards economic investment (the human.market building) with an occasional bonus; no detour required, but reinforces the build-vs-expand tradeoff from Lane 9.

anti_degeneracy.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
rules: cooldown_days prevents a single event dominating a seed line.
No event auto-damages the player or auto-captures regions; combat only occurs through the existing battle bridge when the player chooses to engage a spawned activity.
Declining any choice-event is always safe (compatible with Nature/Dark passivity and low-aggression play).
All randomness is seeded; replaying the same save produces identical events (save/load determinism).

explicit_unknowns: LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED: whether a transient caravan/convoy can be presented as a moving actor along RoadNeighbors; today only the data/state layer is designed. Fallback: a region-pinned icon with no travel animation.
Predicate 'if_player_shelters' needs a one-click campaign choice UI; the current founder HUD has site-interaction buttons but no event-choice modal (coordinate with the Unreal integration lane).
Whether modify_relation should target a specific faction or the nearest same-biome faction is a DESIGN PROPOSAL pending Diplomacy V1 (Lane 4).
